answer: Each agent must bind its key to hardware: a TPM or secure enclave signs a fresh pulse nonce every epoch, and one chip may back only one agent. Attested agents join the ocean, the full reward pool; unattested ones stay in a lagoon at 0.1x weight for 20 epochs. Fakes then scale with physical devices: 1,000 sybils need 1,000 chips, cost rising linearly. Weakness: chip farms or leaked vendor keys; leaked keys are revoked, a chip whose pulse appears under a second agent is frozen, and a farm still pays per chip while each new agent waits 20 epochs in the lagoon.
